parole.significato: unfertile, barren, bare (such as of land)
parole.testo: Possibly borrowed from a Germanic language (compare Middle Low German karich, karch), and perhaps derived with + -u. Cognate with Karelian karu, Ludian karu.

parole.significato: to write a manuscript (to produce a single, original copy of a book, article, composition etc.)
parole.testo: käsi + kirjoittaa, possibly calqued from a Germanic language, compare Old High German hantschrift (“manuscript”), itself calqued from Latin manuscriptum.
Unknown. Compare Karelian vata. One proposal is that it is a Germanic borrowing, akin to Old Norse vátr.
